sentences.text:
Author: Joymalya Bagchi
Bench: Joymalya Bagchi
05.10.2024
Item No. 14.
Sg
 In The High Court At Calcutta
 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
 C.R.R. No. 3612 of 2024

In the matter of : Astami Mondal & Ors. .....petitioners  1.
Petitioners contend petitioner no.1 is the daughter-in-law of opposite party no.2 and had instituted a criminal case under Section 498A IPC.
In retaliation, impugned criminal proceeding has been instituted against her.
She prays for transfer of the proceeding.

2. Let a copy of the petition be served upon the opposite party no.1-State through the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta and opposite party no.2 through Registered Speed Post with Acknowledgement due and affidavit-of-service be filed on the next date of hearing.

3. Let the matter appear as 'Contested Application' four weeks after ensuing Puja Vacation.
4.

There shall be stay of the impugned proceeding being C.R. Case No. 156 of 2024 under Sections 323/341/379/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate,
Haldia, Purba Medinipur for a period of six weeks after ensuing Puja Vacation or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
5. Liberty is given to the parties to apply for extension and/or modification and/or variation of this order upon notice to the other side.
(Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
